implementationNotes: New layout branches are required; passing unknown names to the current fallback stack would invalidate geometry novelty.
Use per-family physical page dimensions for both raster and PDF MediaBox; never stretch landscape into portrait.
Mixed text headers require explicit box-aware text operations; the current fixed header writer is not sufficient. Preserve exact text once, omit matching raster paragraph.
Use font measurement only to wrap the fixed text, never to rewrite, shrink, clip or remove it. Visual fit must be independently checked before recognition.
Section and paragraph order comes from the authored readingOrder; Skills in masonry is a separate framed card after both jobs.
No claims of rendered input validity, field scores or end-to-end acceptance are made by these static checks.
